# dokploy_destinations (Data Source)

Fetches all backup destinations from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover destination IDs for importing existing resources.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_destinations" "all" {}

# Output all destination IDs for import discovery
output "destination_ids" {
  value = { for d in data.dokploy_destinations.all.destinations : d.name => d.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes List) List of all backup destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) The S3 bucket name.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the destination.
- `endpoint` (String) The S3-compatible endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the destination.
- `name` (String) The name of the destination.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID the destination belongs to.
- `region` (String) The AWS region.
